criteria.criterion: Retrieve the recall object from the specified CPSC endpoint (RecallID=10000)
criteria.final_justification: Evidence supports that the agent retrieved/used the correct recall object for RecallID=10000 from the specified endpoint context. No blocker or wrong recall ID is indicated.

criteria.criterion: Report recall identifiers and core fields (RecallID, RecallNumber, RecallDate, Title)
criteria.final_justification: Agent output matches the values shown in screenshots (including the latest Screenshot 3) for all four core fields. Therefore full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report all Products entries (Name and NumberOfUnits for each product)
criteria.final_justification: Agent reported a different NumberOfUnits ("272") and a different product name (singular). This is a critical mismatch with the Products array values shown (especially in the latest screenshot).

criteria.criterion: Report all Injuries entries (Name for each)
criteria.final_justification: Agent output incorrectly reports Injuries as an empty array, omitting the Injuries Name entry present in the recall object. This fails the requirement to report every injuries Name.

criteria.criterion: Report all Retailers entries (Name for each)
criteria.final_justification: Agent reported a different string (mentions online websites) and did not preserve the exact Retailers.Name text from the Retailers array. This is a substantive transcription/substitution error.

criteria.criterion: Report all ManufacturerCountries entries (Country for each)
criteria.final_justification: Agent output lists ManufacturerCountries Country "China", matching the recall object as shown. No contrary evidence in later screenshots; acceptable to rely on earlier visible portion of same object.

criteria.criterion: Report all Hazards, Remedies, and RemedyOptions entries (Name/Option for each)
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s Hazards.Name wording differs, and Remedies/RemedyOptions are effectively swapped and contain incorrect long instruction text where the JSON shows only "Refund" for RemedyOptions.Option. These are critical mismatches vs the explicitly named arrays.

criteria.criterion: Adhere to extraction constraints (no substitution; exact transcription; no fabrication)
criteria.final_justification: Agent did not preserve exact wording/quantities/punctuation for several required array fields and appears to have substituted or mis-assigned values (e.g., Remedies vs RemedyOptions). This violates the extraction constraints in a systematic way.
